# Contribution Log

## AI Contribution

* Used **Claude (Anthropic)** as an AI assistance tool.
* AI helped in writing the **BFS (Breadth-First Search)** maze-solving code.
* AI helped in writing the **DFS (Depth-First Search)** maze-solving code.
* AI helped create the **profiling and timing script** using Python's `time.perf_counter()`.
* AI helped organize the **report structure**.
* AI assisted in drafting the **analysis and justification** of the BFS and DFS results.
* AI assistance was used for coding and documentation support, while the actual experimental results were generated by running the code.

## My Contribution

* I selected and worked on the **6×6 grid maze pathfinding problem**.
* I ran the BFS and DFS programs on my system.
* I performed the profiling experiments using **20,000 iterations per run**.
* I conducted **3 separate runs** for the performance comparison.
* I collected the actual **average execution times** for BFS and DFS.
* I recorded the **number of nodes expanded** by each algorithm.
* I verified the **path lengths** produced by BFS and DFS.
* I reviewed and compared the experimental results.
* I interpreted the results and checked whether the observations were consistent with the actual measurements.
* I reviewed the final report before submission.

## Summary

**AI was mainly used for:** coding assistance, profiling-script preparation, report structure, and drafting.

**My work included:** running the experiments, collecting and verifying the actual results, analyzing the measurements, and reviewing the final submission.
